sloka: अद्य ते मच्छरैश्छिन्नं शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् ।क्रव्यादा व्यपकर्षन्तु विकीर्णं रणपांसुषु ।। ६.१०५.२० ।।
transliteration: adya te maccharaiśchinnaṁ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam ।kravyādā vyapakarṣantu vikīrṇaṁ raṇapāṁsuṣu ।। 6.105.20 ।।

translations.english: "Now, let your head severed by my shafts lying in dust in the battlefield with the shining earrings be dragged by the carnivorous animals."
